reads.AORT: mixed — real double-digit growth and operating leverage collide with a fresh recall, lowered guidance, sharp EPS cuts and negative FCF against 3.7x leverage.
reads.BRBR: strongly-bearish — margin % AND absolute EBITDA fell together with a management-confirmed guide cut and structural pricing-power erosion; discount looks largely earned.
reads.CNXC: mixed — genuine cash generation and a live mix-upgrade thesis sit against heavy 4.1x leverage, a deep GAAP loss, and sharp consensus cuts.
reads.EPAM: mixed — a net-cash, still-growing, AI-scaling franchise de-rated to near-trough multiples, but genuine multi-year margin/ROIC erosion and North America demand softness keep the value-trap risk live.
reads.FUBO: strongly-bearish — idiosyncratic -83% relative collapse, across-the-board FY26 estimate cuts crossing zero, and unfunded cash burn with opaque leverage.
reads.IT: mixed — franchise economics and CV/engagement momentum intact, but revenue is contracting and the forward consensus base keeps being cut.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — stated going-concern doubt with a near-term maturity wall against thin cash while adjusted EBITDA has turned negative and revenue is contracting.
reads.NCNO: mixed — genuine absolute-EBITDA/cash inflection and sub-peer forward multiples set against decelerating top-line growth and rising short interest.
reads.SMPL: mixed — peer-best balance sheet and two growing brands offset a real share-loss-in-a-growing-category and a confirmed forward step-down.
reads.VITL: mixed — a self-funded, growing brand doing a self-inflicted price-gap reset, but FY26 profit consensus collapsed ~97% and trial is slowing.
reads.VRRM: strongly-bearish — a >10%-revenue customer termination cutting $135–145M annualized plus CEO exit drove an ~81% idiosyncratic collapse and forward step-down.
